meta.smoothing: P(s|t) = (n_st + m*P(s)) / (n_t + m), m = pseudo-teams of shrinkage toward the marginal. Pairs with n_st == 0 are omitted from `cooccur`; their value is the shrinkage limit m*P(s)/(n_t+m), recomputed by SpeciesPriorTable.conditional.
meta.vocabulary: species ID strings on the BASE-form basis (agents.gen3_data.species.base_form_ids(); an alternate forme is normalized to its base_species, since a forme shares its base's national-dex num). `species_nums` maps each id to that num — the index every model table (layout['max_species']) uses.
